preprocessing: OneHotEncoder on source, passthrough on boolean features
exclusions: stage = 'Junk' AND junk_reason_id IS NULL (junk stage with no recorded reason) — 158 rows
metrics_note: Metrics computed by evaluating junk_classifier.joblib against crm.db using the model author's exact feature derivation AND training-set exclusions: leads in a terminal_type='bot' stage (79) and leads in the 'Junk' stage with junk_reason_id IS NULL (158) are removed, leaving 558 of the 795 current non-deleted leads. train/test are an 80/20 stratified split (random_state=42) for evaluation only, not the original training split. The original model reported ~82.9% on 524 rows; the exclusion rules match exactly, but the database has grown since training (761 -> 795 leads), so 558 remain here rather than 524, and measured test accuracy is 0.795.
